mentions.indieAngle: The software angle, not the brooms: a booking + recurring billing + cleaner-dispatch SaaS for one-city cleaning companies in PL (Warsaw / Kraków / Wrocław), with a "book in 60 seconds" page and SMS day-before confirmations. Charge €79–€149/mo per operator.

whyItPrints: Recurring home services with card-on-file. $0 seat MRR because customers pay per clean; L30 is steady (~$18k) and all-time is already ~$275k in ~16 months. Ads + SEO + TikTok — sweaty, not sexy.
whyThisMatters:
Households in Reno and Sparks book a flat-rate clean, then call a person if the plan changes. The number on the site is 775-376-5527. Weekly, every two weeks, or every four weeks. Also a deep clean, a move-out, a rental turnover, or a light office job.

Weekly is 20 percent off. Every two weeks is 15. Every four weeks is 10. A new recurring client can get the first visit as a deep clean if they finish three visits in a row. Cleaners are background-checked, and the price is set before they arrive. Missed spots have a 24-hour guarantee.

The site says 4.9 on Google from more than 90 reviews. The company started in May 2025.
